d: Interior view of the shipyard at Saardam Many carpenters at work, among them Peter Michaelow and Peter Ivanov
Tsar. Ivanov. Later Master Browe's voice
The previous ones. van Bett. Master Browe.

Tsar, Ivanov sit at the front left side and smoke. Carpenters, women and girls sit partly at tables and drink, partly they walk around, shackle, etc. When raising the curtain, the whole has to show a living picture.
The previous ones. Marquis of Chateauneuf.
Master Browe is coming from behind.
Van Bett gravitsisch eingeierend and contemplatively walking around the hall; he is closely followed by a counselor, who wears a lot of sheet music; then young girls and boys, welcoming him, enter.
